chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: The fallen money bag prank
summary: McRae hid one of the bags at the Kansas City gate count to tease Chick and the Gales.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: We had like five thousand before the place even opened. He jumped on a plane and flew out there. A lot of money involved, you know.

After the dance, they was sitting there counting the money. Had all this money on the table and putting it into these bank bags. Like a thousand dollars in this bag and a thousand dollars in this bag.

They had it all lined up. And I'm sitting on the desk and they over there. One of the bags happened to fall on the floor. And I pushed the bag under the table. I said, "Oh I got me some money tonight!" So I was just going to make them squirm. They're just sitting there. They counted those bags, they were looking for the money. And Chick said, "Hey, Teddy, ain't you got one of those bags?"
